methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected directly from each provider's pricing page on the accessed date of 2026-06-13, except where the vendor page blocked automated access (Intuit/QuickBooks and Xero both returned HTTP 503/timeout to automated fetch), in which case figures were taken from clearly-cited corroborating sources that quote the published list rates. Prices are recorded as the regular published monthly USD rate (not introductory/promotional discounts); per-seat or per-additional-user pricing is noted in billingModel and notes. Quote-only / 'Let's Talk' / 'contact sales' tiers carry a null monthlyUsd, and call-center metrics (minutes, calls, overage) are null because they do not apply to accounting software.
